rules.title: Relocation payments for owner/relative move-in, demolition/removal, temporary capital improvement, and substantial rehabilitation evictions
rules.requirement: Landlords evicting tenants for owner/relative move-in, demolition or permanent removal of a unit from housing use, temporary capital improvement work, or substantial rehabilitation must pay relocation amounts per tenant, capped per unit, plus an additional amount for each elderly (60+) or disabled tenant or household with minor children. Amounts are set by the date the eviction notice is served.
rules.key_value: For notices served 3/01/26–2/28/27: $8,245.00 per tenant; max $24,733.00 per unit; plus $5,497.00 for each elderly (60+) or disabled tenant or household with minor child(ren)
rules.coverage_conditions: Tenants in San Francisco Rent Ordinance-covered units served with a termination notice based on owner/relative move-in, demolition/permanent removal from housing use, temporary capital improvement work, or substantial rehabilitation.
rules.exemptions: Temporary capital improvement evictions of less than 20 days are governed by Cal. Civ. Code § 1947.9, not Rent Ordinance § 37.9C.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Applies only to evictions on specified no-fault grounds; amount depends on date of service of the eviction notice and household composition (elderly/disabled/minor children).

rules.citation: San Francisco Rent Ordinance (S.F. Admin. Code) § 37.9C
rules.quoted_span: *The amount of relocation payments for temporary capital improvement evictions for less than 20 days is governed by California Civil Code Section 1947.9 and not by Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C.
rules.conflict_note: Effective date inferred from the earliest rate period in the archive (8/10/06); current rate period 3/01/26–2/28/27 applies on the query date. Rates adjust annually each March 1.

rules.title: Relocation payments for Ellis Act evictions
rules.requirement: Landlords withdrawing units from the rental market under the Ellis Act must pay relocation amounts per tenant, capped per unit, plus an additional amount for each elderly (62+) or disabled tenant. Amounts are set by the date the eviction notice is served.
rules.key_value: For notices served 3/01/26–2/28/27: $11,110.05 per tenant; max $33,330.13 per unit; plus $7,443.90 for each elderly (62+) or disabled tenant
rules.coverage_conditions: Tenants in San Francisco served with a termination notice under the Ellis Act (withdrawal of units from rental use).

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Applies only to Ellis Act evictions; amount depends on date of service of the eviction notice and whether tenant is elderly (62+) or disabled.

rules.citation: San Francisco Rent Ordinance (S.F. Admin. Code ch. 37), Ellis Act relocation provision (section not stated in document)
rules.quoted_span: Relocation payments for tenants evicted under the Ellis Act
rules.conflict_note: Document does not give the specific ordinance section or effective date; archive rates begin 3/01/06. Current rate period 3/01/26–2/28/27 applies on the query date.

rules.title: Relocation for temporary capital improvement displacement under 20 days
rules.requirement: Relocation payments for temporary capital improvement evictions lasting less than 20 days in San Francisco are governed by California Civil Code § 1947.9 rather than the local Rent Ordinance § 37.9C.
rules.coverage_conditions: Tenants temporarily displaced for capital improvement work for less than 20 days (as applied in San Francisco).

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Applies only to temporary capital improvement displacement of less than 20 days.

rules.quoted_span: *The amount of relocation payments for temporary capital improvement evictions for less than 20 days is governed by California Civil Code Section 1947.9 and not by Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C.
rules.conflict_note: Document only references the statute; amounts and effective date are not stated.
